sources.name: Anyscale press release, Founders of Open Source Project Ray Launch Anyscale

profile_text.body:
Anyscale is a for-profit startup founded in 2019 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. According to its site, it is powered by Ray and helps AI builders run data-intensive workloads to build and deploy foundation models and AI at scale on any cloud. The company describes its platform as orchestrating model training across GPU clusters with elastic scaling, last-mile data preprocessing, and GPU observability, and it promotes a webinar on production-ready distributed inference with Ray Serve. A testimonial on the site from Anastasis Germanidis credits Anyscale with the flexibility to scale generative AI workloads seamlessly.

The company was launched by the founders of the open source project Ray, and a press release on its site announced USD 20.6m in funding to democratize distributed programming. No products are tracked in the record, and no lawsuits, MCP servers, or other filings are listed. The only additional held fact is a law exposure count of 281 for California.
